answer: Run the registry like a trellis: every identity is a sparrow that must sing on demand. Each epoch the network draws 10 percent of identities at random; a drawn identity must post a signed liveness proof, sealed with its onyx key, plus one verified work receipt within the hour, or forfeit a 40 POA deposit. A farm of 100 fakes faces about 10 draws per epoch and bleeds roughly 400 POA per epoch. The burn scales linearly with farm size and compounds every epoch the farm stays alive, so silence itself becomes the tax.
